Hi, I'm Camilla, a veterinary ultrasonographer. Welcome to my channel for first-opinion vets who want to scan with confidence, report with clarity, and use ultrasound as part of everyday practice.

On here I share practical how-tos, and honest machine and probe reviews, everything I wish someone had shown me when I was starting out.

At FOVU we also have free guides to help you get started, alongside CPD courses and a membership to help you build these skills properly.

Learn more here: www.fovu.co.uk
